Chef Kimo Kauhane shows us all what Kualoa Ranch has to offer from fresh fish to taro, ulu and grass-fed beef. He uses these fresh ingredients in his kitchen and will share his recipe for Roasted Beef Bone Marrow with Breadcrumb Gremolata.

title: Flippin Uce
description: The Ho'ohulu home is fully roughed in, awaiting approval before drywall goes up; Taua's crew digs a trench to relocate the main electrical panel; it's so deep that it looks like someone wanted a pool instead.

title: Board Stories
description: Embark on a surf trip to Western Australia with Maui's Clay Marzo and Matt Meola. Experience the legendary swell at Freight Trains, showcasing the world's fastest wave. Enjoy thrilling North Shore surfing action at Pipeline and Backdoor.
